program_name: Apple One (1) Year Limited Warranty (Apple Watch; U.S.)
coverage_summary: Apple Watch bought in the U.S. (not Apple Watch Edition), for faults in the first year
watch_phrases: BY USING YOUR APPLE-BRANDED HARDWARE PRODUCT YOU ARE AGREEING TO BE BOUND BY THE TERMS OF THE APPLE ONE (1) YEAR LIMITED WARRANTY
Apple may restrict warranty service for hardware products to the country where Apple or its Authorized Distributors originally sold the device
coverage: Defects in materials and workmanship when used normally in accordance with Apple's published guidelines, for one year from the date of original retail purchase by the end-user purchaser
remedy: At Apple's option: repair with new or previously used Apple genuine parts, replacement with the same model (or with your consent a product with the same or substantially similar features), or a refund of the purchase price
mandatory_conditions: The claim is submitted to Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider during the one-year Warranty Period
The fault is a defect in materials or workmanship, with the watch used normally in line with Apple's published guidelines
Apple or its agents may require proof of purchase details and may ask diagnostic questions before service
During warranty service the watch's storage is deleted and reformatted, so keep a backup (on iPhone, Apple Watch backs up to the paired iPhone)
exclusions_and_caveats: Not covered: damage caused by accident, abuse, misuse, fire, earthquake or other external cause

Not covered: consumable parts such as batteries or protective coatings that diminish over time, and cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, broken plastic on ports), unless the failure is due to a defect in materials or workmanship
Not covered: damage from service by anyone other than Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider, or a watch modified without Apple's written permission. Don't open the watch yourself
Not covered: defects caused by normal wear and tear or normal aging, or a watch whose serial number has been removed or defaced
Apple may restrict warranty service to the country where the watch was originally sold
Apple Watch Edition has its own warranty document, so it is not part of this record. A band bought on its own is an accessory, covered by Apple's accessory warranty instead
This is the U.S. version of Apple's warranty. Other countries have their own version, and consumer law may give you further rights
claim_action: Contact Apple Support, or visit an Apple Store or Apple Authorized Service Provider, before {deadline}. To see your coverage, sign in at mysupport.apple.com. Have proof of purchase ready.
visible_damage_note: Visible physical damage was recorded in the evidence photo. Apple's warranty does not cover damage caused by accident or other external causes; AppleCare coverage, if you have it, may.
